description: Intent benchmark Round 12 — 280 targeted edge-case prompts addressing documented DistilBERT / phi4 misclassification patterns. Primary focus: (1) first-person-prefix + action-verb ambiguity ('I need/want you to X' → command_automate vs memory_store), (2) personal lifestyle / appointment declarations (→ memory_store), (3) build/create/make requests (→ command_automate), (4) past-tense action reports (→ memory_store), (5) personal-history queries (→ memory_retrieve vs web_search), (6) system resource queries (→ command_automate vs memory_retrieve). Zero overlap with Rounds 1-11.
themes: Jordan Walsh (UX recruiter, starts April), Suki (rescue cat), cold brew coffee / pour-over ritual, marathon qualifying race (Boston 2027), Rust ownership system, Beekeeping hobby (colony named Beatrice), Margarita (Spanish tutor), fermented foods (kefir, kimchi), home-office ergonomics upgrade, annual skin cancer screening, Canva Pro account, GitHub Copilot workspace setup, backpacking trip to Japanese Alps
